content.text: The return of Pacquiao brings to light significant concerns regarding the management of boxers who come back to the ring at an older age.
Typically, a fighter returning from retirement transitions back into the sport through preliminary tune-up bouts.
Nicola Adams: said seeing the young boxers 'makes me relive everything – I almost wanted to get back in the ring.'
Pacquiao exhibited a highly energetic style, characterized by his bouncing movements, shifting angles, and keen reflexes.
